description: This file defines the TraceInformation class, which encapsulates tracing data such as trace URI and tags, including a builder for constructing instances.

classes.name: TraceInformation
classes.description: A data class holding trace URI and associated tags for tracing purposes.

classes.name: TraceInformation.Builder
classes.description: A builder class to facilitate creation of immutable TraceInformation instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on traceUri and tags.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the TraceInformation object.
